attacks.claim: A failed unpublish is not handled. The request is awaited with no try/catch, no error state, and no user feedback, so a story can stay live while the editor believes it was pulled. For an embargo-break scenario that is a serious failure mode.
attacks.evidence: if (ok) await onUnpublish(draft.id);  ABSENT: any catch, error message, or retry path around onUnpublish
